lieux.name: Les Planches
lieux.description:
Take a walk along the famous wooden promenade of Deauville, lined with cabins bearing the names
                        of great figures from cinema.

lieux.name: Les Franciscaines
lieux.description:
Discover this cultural site installed in an old monastery, between exhibitions, museum, library
                        and history of Deauville.

lieux.name: Casino Barrière Deauville
lieux.description:
Discover the emblematic casino of Deauville, a symbol of the city's elegance and entertainment,
                        offering games, shows and a unique atmosphere.

lieux.name: Hôtel Le Normandy
lieux.description:
Discover one of Deauville's most iconic hotels, recognizable by its timber-framed facades and
                        Anglo-Norman style.

lieux.name: Place de Morny
lieux.description: Stroll around this central square surrounded by shops, a true meeting point in the heart of Deauville.

lieux.name: Bassin Morny
lieux.description: Stroll around the Bassin Morny and enjoy the maritime atmosphere in the heart of Deauville.

lieux.name: Bains Poméiens
lieux.description: Enjoy these aquatic facilities to cool off in the heart of Deauville.

lieux.name: Hippodrome de Deauville-La Touques
lieux.description: Discover the world of horse racing in this historic racetrack located in the heart of Deauville.

restaurants.name: L'Essentiel
restaurants.description: A refined table that offers creative cuisine around seasonal products.

restaurants.name: L'Étoile des Mers
restaurants.description: A venue focused on seafood, perfect for discovering mussels, fish and other Norman specialties.

restaurants.name: Mamma Mia
restaurants.description: A friendly restaurant offering refined French cuisine in the heart of Deauville.

restaurants.name: Le Hibouville
restaurants.description: A lively address on the place of Morny, ideal for dining or having a drink in the heart of Deauville.

restaurants.name: Le Drakkar
restaurants.description: A friendly address in Deauville for sharing a meal in a relaxed atmosphere, just steps from the city center's animation.

restaurants.name: L'Étage
restaurants.description: A friendly restaurant offering refined French cuisine in the heart of Deauville.

restaurants.name: La Cantine de Deauville
restaurants.description: A friendly address offering generous and delicious cuisine, ideal for sharing a warm moment in the heart of Deauville.
